title: Community rule object
description: Reusable representation of a group, forum, or platform rule with scope, examples, evidence needs, and action options.

title: Moderator checklist item
description: A structured question a moderator should answer before applying a warning, removal, escalation, or appeal decision.

title: Harassment escalation trigger
description: Routes targeted abuse, threats, brigading, or repeated unwanted contact to a human moderation queue with evidence requirements.

title: Spam and scam review route
description: Separates low-risk spam cleanup from higher-risk scam, impersonation, payment, or marketplace-abuse reports.

title: Appeal review question
description: Standardized appeal question that asks whether evidence, rule mapping, notice, and proportional action were adequate.

title: Group norm knowledge object
description: Captures local group norms such as posting format, sale rules, off-topic limits, civility standards, and moderator notes.

title: Misinformation context route
description: Routes disputed claims to citation, source-quality, correction, or expert-review workflows rather than generic content deletion.

title: Child safety handoff route
description: High-risk safety handoff object that routes suspected child-safety concerns to specialized review, preservation, and legal/safety workflows without exposing unsafe details.

title: Self-harm crisis escalation
description: Escalation object for crisis-language reports that prioritizes safety resources, human review, and jurisdiction-appropriate emergency handling.

title: Transparency log event
description: Audit component describing moderation action, policy mapping, evidence, appeal path, reviewer type, and model/tool involvement.
